title: A desk worker who has been removed can still open the whole member list on his phone, for as long as he keeps it offline
what: For the offline front desk, the admin app keeps a full copy of the gym (members, mobile numbers, plans, dues, payments) on each signed-in device. That copy is thrown away only when the device next reaches the server and finds its sign-in no longer works, or on sign-out. It has no age limit. A desk worker who leaves, or is removed by the owner, can turn on airplane mode and keep opening the admin app with the gym's member list as it was on his last day, for months. The same is true for a device not opened for 6 months: it opens with a 6-month-old copy.
expected: The kept copy stops opening after a set time without reaching the server (for example 7 days), so a removed person's device cannot keep showing member details, and the owner is told how long a device keeps the copy.
how_often: whenever a signed-in desk device is kept offline after its person is removed
fix_line: Stop opening the kept copy once it has not reached the server for a set number of days

items.reason: Web panel: no install package, sideload, Play package or watch/phone version split in this area. The service worker takes over at once, fetches from the network first and drops files the new page no longer names; the app has no lazy-loaded parts, so an old tab never asks for a file that is gone. Kept data has a shape number (v 1) on the gym copy and the offline waiting list; nothing has changed shape yet, so no migration has run (a future change would empty the waiting list, see outbox.ts:116-120, so it will need a migration then). Open tab across a deploy: never told a new version is out, so What's new and new dots stay old until reload: same root cause as FN-B-time-panel-assistant-01.

Trial end and paid-until end: the Today line counts days from the clock on each draw and the stopped-paying line replaces it when the plan lock is on. Read-only gym with no way to reach MettleUp: FN-L14-panel-ui-shell-03; paused vs on hold words: FN-B-words-panel-logic-1-02. Pause approvals past plan end: FN-B-time-panel-logic-2-01. Member leaves and returns: joining online again brings the archived member back (JoinedOnlineCard 278-295); a renew from his page leaves him hidden: FN-B-time-panel-screens-1-01. Staff leaves: the offline copy keeps opening on a removed person's device: FN-B-time-panel-ui-shell-01 (new). Owner changes phone: quick buttons and Get started are per device: FN-A5-panel-ui-shell-3-01, FN-B-time-panel-logic-1-02. Year end: month labels carry the year. Leap day and 29-31 starts: FN-B-time-panel-forms-01. 6 months unopened: payments older than 31 days wait for the owner with plain words; the kept copy has no age limit (FN-B-time-panel-ui-shell-01).

Numbers to confirm only covers numbers typed after the 2 Nov fix; links made before it are never checked: FN-B-time-panel-shop-01. The 'Your gym is ready' page is for new gyms only and never says where the code and join link live later: FN-L9-panel-ui-shell-06. The sign-in-only install offer applies to every signed-in person, old or new.
No path for links made before the desk check: the card lists only pending rows, and nothing lists or removes an old link.
Rule applied: no path, so the existing finding stands (reused, not repeated).

A brand-new browser only remembers the newest update and shows no What's new card; new dots skip features older than the gym's set-up day and pages not on the person's menu, and are off for the desk and the demo. The bell counts MettleUp messages sent before a new gym joined: FN-B-time-panel-logic-1-04. A long-running gym on a new device sees Get started again: FN-B-time-panel-logic-1-02.
Rule applied: the two marks shown to brand-new gyms or devices on things not new to them are already findings (reused).
